 Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver’s Christmas tradition lives on years after divorce
 The pair still get together on special occasions
 © Getty Images 
 Maria Loreto Senior Writer NOVEMBER 17, 2026 12:35 PM EST NOV 17, 2026, 12:35 PM EST 
 Arnold Schwarzenegger is opening up about one of his family's Christmas traditions. He reveals that even though he and Maria Shriver have been divorced for years, the two are still a family. 
 © Getty Christina Schwarzenegger, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Patrick Schwarzenegger, Maria Shriver and Katherine Schwarzenegger 2017 
 In an interview with PEOPLE , Schwarzenegger revealed that he and Shriver still celebrate Christmas together every year. “Even though we’re divorced, the kids, they like to see you always together," he said. 
 “The family is always together." 
 He revealed that he and Shriver's kids, which include Katherine ,  Patrick , Christina , and Christopher , love to spend time with both of their parents on holidays. 
 © Getty Images Arnold Schwarzenegger & Maria Shriver's rare reunion photo marks his 69th birthday

 “The kids love that. So we do that, we continue with that tradition," said Schwarzenegger. He shared that the family spends Christmas at Shriver's place, where she decorates with a large Christmas tree. 
 He also revealed that he's passed down some Austrian Christmas traditions to his children, including one of his family's traditions, where the Christmas tree is so tall that it touches the ceiling. 
 Schwarzenegger and Shriver's long-lasting relationship
 © Getty Arnold and Maria Shriver on February 18, 2011, before their split 
 Arnold Schwarzenegger and Maria Shriver have known each other for many years, first meeting in 1977. Years later, in 1986, the two got married, remaining together until 2011, staying together for 15 years. Then, it was revealed that Schwarzenegger had a child with another woman, Joseph Baena, who remains in contact with Schwarzenegger and is part of his life. 
 The affair became a notorious scandal, with Schwarzenegger apologizing and the couple getting a divorce. It finalized in 2021, after almost 10 years of separation. Still, despite how challenging it all was, the two remain friendly and a part of each other's lives, with both discussing the process extensively with the media, opting for honesty. 
 Last year, Shriver published a book titled " I Am Maria ," containing poems and reflections on her life. In an interview with PEOPLE , she revealed that she and Schwarzenegger are in a good place and have managed to heal their dynamic. 
 "We laugh a lot about our kids, our grandkids, ourselves, and we are proud of the fact that we are still in conversation. For almost 50 years!" she said.
 © Patrick Schwarzenegger/Instagram Arnold has previously said that his “chapter with Maria will continue on forever” despite their separate lives.
